1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi.

2.text: Uwiteka ni wowe mpungiraho,Singakorwe n'isoni,Unkize ku bwo gukiranuka kwawe.

3.text: Untegere ugutwi utebuke unkize,Umbere igitare gikomeye,Inzu y'igihome yo kunkiza.

4.text: Kuko ari wowe gitare cyanjye n'igihome kinkingira,Nuko ku bw'izina ryawe unjye imbere unyobore.

5.text: Unkure mu kigoyi banteze rwihishwa,Kuko ari wowe gihome kinkingira.

6.text: Mu maboko yawe ni ho mbikije ubugingo bwanjye,Uwiteka Mana y'umurava, warancunguye.

7.text: Nanga abita ku bitagira umumaro by'ibinyoma,Ku bwanjye niringira Uwiteka.

8.text: Nzajya nezerwa nishimira imbabazi zawe,Kuko warebye amakuba yanjye n'ibyago byanjye,Wamenye imibabaro y'umutima wanjye,

9.text: Kandi utankingiraniye gufatwa n'amaboko y'umwanzi,Washyize ibirenge byanjye ahantu hagari.

10.text: Uwiteka umbabarire kuko mbabaye,Mu maso hanjye hananurwa n'umubabaro,Kandi n'ubugingo bwanjye n'umubiri binanuwe na wo.

11.text: Kuko iminsi yo kubaho kwanjye nyihoranamo agahinda,N'imyaka yanjye nkayimara nsuhuza umutima.Intege zanjye zimarwa no gukiranirwa kwanjye,Amagufwa yanjye arananutse.

12.text: Ku bw'abanzi banjye bose mpindutse igitutsi,Ni koko mpindukiye abaturanyi banjye igitutsi gikomeye,N'abamenyi banjye mbahindukiye igiteye ubwoba,Abandebye mu nzira barampunga.

14.text: Kuko numvise benshi bambeshya,Ubwoba bukantera impande zose,Ubwo bangīraga inama,Bagashaka uburyo banyica.

15.text: Ariko ku bwanjye ni wowe niringiye Uwiteka,Naravuze nti “Uri Imana yanjye.”

16.text: Ibihe byanjye biri mu maboko yawe,Unkize amaboko y'abanzi banjye n'abangenza,

17.text: Umurikishirize umugaragu wawe mu maso hawe,Unkize ku bw'imbabazi zawe.

18.text: Uwiteka, ne gukorwa n'isoni kuko ngutakiye,Abanyabyaha abe ari bo bakorwa n'isoni,Bacecekere ikuzimu.

19.text: Indimi z'ibinyoma zigobwe,Zivugana umukiranutsi agasuzuguro,N'ubwibone no kugayana.

20.text: Erega kugira neza kwawe ni kwinshi,Uko wabikiye abakubaha,Uko wakorereye abaguhungiraho mu maso y'abantu.

21.text: Mu bwihisho bwo mu maso yawe,Ni ho uzabahisha inama mbi z'abantu,Uzabahisha mu ihema gutongana kw'indimi.

22.text: Uwiteka ahimbazwe,Kuko yanyerekeye imbabazi ze zitangaza,Mu mudugudu ufite igihome gikomeye.

23.text: Ku bwanjye navuganye ubwira nti“Nciriwe mu maso yawe,Ariko ngutakiye wumva ijwi ryo kwinginga kwanjye.”

24.text: Mukunde Uwiteka mwa bakunzi be mwese mwe,Uwiteka arinda abanyamurava,Yitura byinshi ūkora iby'ubwibone.

25.text: Mwa bategereza Uwiteka mwese mwe,Nimukomere, imitima yanyu ihumure.
